name: Bloodforged gear grants no PvE Power
contract: Bloodforged Avenger's Armor carried a PvE Power (+38) marker before the marker data was corrected. Equipping it must leave a level 60 player's damage dealt to and taken from a creature at the base value. Requires PvePower.Enable = 1 in coa.conf.

steps.label: A Bloodforged chestpiece adds no damage dealt
A Bloodforged chestpiece removes no damage taken
